name: Currier Orchards
description: Currier Orchards is an independent pumpkin patch in Merrimack, NH. It grows Apples, Pumpkins, Peas, and Honey, with picking through autumn and spring. The harvest is typically at its peak in autumn. Check the website or call ahead for current hours and what is in season.
Seasonal availability typically runs from Aug – Nov in this growing zone.
